chapters.caption_en: The article is created, stating that the Finnish Civil War was fought between the Reds and the Whites.
A section is added to discuss the various names of the conflict, including 'War of Freedom (vapaussota)' and 'Class War (luokkasota)'.
The article undergoes rapid growth in September 2005, expanding to about 67,000 characters.
An editor briefly changes a heading to 'War of Freedom (vapaussota)', but the change is undone within two minutes.
Between 2006 and 2009, the page is wiped and restored four times, including one instance involving 145,000 characters.
An editor attempts to replace 'Civil War (sisällissota)' with 'War of Freedom (vapaussota)' in several headings, but the changes are reverted.
About 17,000 characters are removed as the timeline is moved to its own separate article.
Another attempt to rename a section to 'War of Freedom (vapaussota)' is undone after one minute.
The article now contains nearly 200,000 characters and has undergone over 3,300 versions.
